notes.title: Fixing up bugs!
notes.notes:
Thank you all who have been playing Towards The Pantheon! A few of you have reported a few bugs and I've been at work fixing them. Some of them are fixed in the current build. If you experience any bugs or crashes, please contact connor@connorlinning.com with some details so that I can document and fix them.

Lastly, please leave a review for the game when you have time and spread the word about Towards The Pantheon, as word of mouth is important for indie developers! I hope you're having a great time playing the game! - Connor
